value.name: Daniel asks about remembered case
value.description: Daniel engages in an uncharacteristically open conversation by asking about a case Rosa had mentioned weeks earlier and correctly recalling the parties' names.
evidence: Tonight he wanted nothing from her. He asked her about a case she had mentioned in passing two weeks ago and remembered the names of the parties, which she had not expected him to remember

value.name: Rosa reconsiders Daniel
value.description: Rosa realizes she can imagine Daniel as a friend rather than someone who only wants something from her.
evidence: she found, talking to him, that the version of Daniel she was talking to was a version she could imagine being friends with

value.name: Rosa announces dinner
value.description: Rosa comes from the kitchen to say dinner is ready and that she won the salt dispute, while Lucia is sulking.
evidence: Rosa came out of the kitchen and said dinner was ready and that the salt question had been resolved in her favor and that Lucia was sulking

value.name: Lucia denies sulking
value.description: Lucia follows Rosa out and insists she is not sulking but merely reserving judgment.
evidence: Lucia came out behind her and said she was not sulking, she was reserving judgment

value.name: Family sits for dinner
value.description: The group sits down at a table set for four with the good plates and begins an extended dinner together.
evidence: they sat down at the dining table, which had been set for four with the good plates

value.name: Dinner proves excellent
value.description: The meal is described as excellent, with stew and bakery bread served at the table.
evidence: the stew was excellent, and the bread was the bread from the bakery two blocks east

value.name: Conversation deepens over dinner
value.description: Over two hours, the dinner conversation moves through weather, Lucia's editing work, Daniel's firm, and a story from Rosa's past.
evidence: the conversation moved, over the course of two hours, from the weather to a film Lucia was editing to a building Daniel's firm was working on to a story Rosa told about Mrs. Serrano in 1987
value.time_hint: over the course of two hours

value.name: Rosa tells old Mrs. Serrano story
value.description: Rosa recounts a story about Mrs. Serrano from 1987 that the children have never heard before.
evidence: a story Rosa told about Mrs. Serrano in 1987 that none of the children had heard before

value.name: Lucia laughs and cries at story
value.description: Rosa's story makes Lucia laugh, then cry a little, then laugh again.
evidence: that made Lucia put down her fork and laugh and then, a moment later, cry a little, and then laugh again

value.name: Daniel comforts his sister
value.description: Daniel reaches across the table and briefly touches his sister's wrist in a small gesture of comfort.
evidence: Daniel reached across the table and put his hand briefly on his sister's wrist
